title: EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3
best_for_zh: 需要审计主观生成评测、judge model、prompt snapshot、repetition/slop 风格代理指标的读者。
one_line: EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3 evaluates model creative-writing outputs with a judge-based leaderboard.
EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3 用 LLM judge 和风格统计列评估模型创意写作输出。
why: It is a useful example of subjective generation evaluation that needs judge and prompt-snapshot audit.
inclusion_reason: It is a visible LLM-judge creative-writing benchmark where subjectivity and style-proxy risks matter.

title: Problem
问题
html:
EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3 asks how to compare language models on open-ended creative prose quality. The primary source is the public EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3 leaderboard page.

The decision boundary is that this is a subjective generation leaderboard, not a factual verifier, programmatic benchmark, or training dataset. The evaluation surface is a set of writing prompts, model outputs, judge scores, and auxiliary style statistics.

It matters because creative-writing evaluation exposes a hard benchmark problem: useful judgments are qualitative, but leaderboard numbers can look more objective than their judge and prompt choices justify.

EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3 问的是：如何比较语言模型的开放式 creative prose quality。主来源是公开的 EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3 leaderboard 页面。

边界是：它是主观生成 leaderboard，不是 factual verifier，不是 programmatic benchmark，也不是训练数据集。评测表面是一组 writing prompts、model outputs、judge scores 和辅助风格统计。

它重要是因为 creative-writing evaluation 暴露了一个难题：判断本身是 qualitative，但 leaderboard numbers 很容易显得比实际 judge 和 prompt choices 更客观。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core contribution is a maintained creative-writing benchmark page with judge-based scores plus diagnostic columns for repetition and overused model-like phrasing. The mechanism is to generate prose for prompts, judge the output, and show leaderboard-level comparisons.

The closest comparisons are human-preference writing evaluations and general chat leaderboards. The change is a domain-specific creative-writing surface, with style-proxy columns that try to expose repetitive or formulaic output.

The feedback contract is an LLM-judge contract, so its meaning depends on the prompt set, judge model, rubric, generation settings, and leaderboard snapshot.

核心贡献是一个持续维护的 creative-writing benchmark 页面，包含 judge-based scores，以及 repetition 和 overused model-like phrasing 的诊断列。机制是让模型按 prompts 生成 prose，再由 judge 评分并在 leaderboard 上比较。

最近的参照物是 human-preference writing evaluations 和 general chat leaderboards。这里的变化是 domain-specific creative-writing surface，并用 style-proxy columns 暴露重复和公式化输出。

反馈契约是 LLM-judge contract，因此含义取决于 prompt set、judge model、rubric、generation settings 和 leaderboard snapshot。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are creative-writing prompts and model completions. The public page verifies the Creative Writing v3 leaderboard, score column, repetition column, and slop column.

Pipeline: collect model outputs for the writing prompts, score them with the benchmark judge, compute repetition from common words/bigrams/trigrams, compute slop from a list of overused phrases, then publish the leaderboard. Outputs are model scores and style diagnostics.

Reproducibility requires prompt set, model output text, judge model, judging prompt, generation settings, repetition/slop implementations, and leaderboard date.

输入是 creative-writing prompts 和模型 completions。公开页面核实了 Creative Writing v3 leaderboard、score column、repetition column 和 slop column。

流程是：收集模型对写作 prompts 的输出，用 benchmark judge 评分，从常见 words/bigrams/trigrams 计算 repetition，用 overused phrases 列表计算 slop，再发布 leaderboard。输出是 model scores 和 style diagnostics。

复现前需要 prompt set、model output text、judge model、judging prompt、generation settings、repetition/slop implementations 和 leaderboard date。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official page verifies that Creative Writing v3 is an LLM-judged creative writing benchmark and that the leaderboard reports score, repetition, and slop-related diagnostics. The page also links to the about section for benchmark details.

The strongest evidence is row-level prompt, output, judge decision, and style-statistic computation. Those row-level artifacts were not verified as a downloadable release in this pass.

The evidence boundary is therefore medium-confidence: the public leaderboard exists and exposes aggregate comparisons, but the prompt set, judge model, rubric, and raw judgments need additional audit before strong reuse.

官方页面核实 Creative Writing v3 是 LLM-judged creative writing benchmark，并且 leaderboard 报告 score、repetition 和 slop 相关诊断列。页面还链接到 about section 说明 benchmark details。

最强证据应是 row-level prompt、output、judge decision 和 style-statistic computation。本轮没有核验到这些逐样本 artifact 作为可下载 release。

因此证据边界是中等置信：public leaderboard 存在并暴露 aggregate comparisons，但 prompt set、judge model、rubric 和 raw judgments 需要进一步审计后才能强复用。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is generic chatbot preference evaluation or ad hoc human review of creative writing. Creative Writing v3 changes the surface by making writing quality a dedicated leaderboard with style diagnostics.

The quality signal is that the page does not rely only on one score; it also exposes repetition and slop proxies. What is not new is LLM-as-judge evaluation itself.

Before reuse, inspect whether the style proxies match the intended writing domain, whether the judge rewards originality or just familiar prose markers, and whether the prompts have leaked.

已有基线是 generic chatbot preference evaluation 或对 creative writing 的临时人工评审。Creative Writing v3 的变化是把 writing quality 做成专门 leaderboard，并加入 style diagnostics。

质量信号是页面不只依赖一个 score；它还暴露 repetition 和 slop proxies。不新的是 LLM-as-judge evaluation 本身。

复用前要检查 style proxies 是否适合目标写作领域，judge 是否奖励 originality 而不只是熟悉的 prose markers，以及 prompts 是否泄漏。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The score is subjective and judge-dependent. A high score does not prove human preference, literary quality across cultures, or suitability for a specific writing task.

Repetition and slop columns are useful diagnostics, but they are proxies. They can penalize legitimate stylistic repetition or reward outputs that avoid known overused phrases while remaining poor writing.

Prompt set, judge model, generation settings, and leaderboard refresh policy were not fully verified, so snapshot discipline is required.

分数是主观且依赖 judge 的。高分不证明 human preference、跨文化 literary quality，也不证明适合某个具体写作任务。

repetition 和 slop columns 是有用诊断，但它们只是 proxies。它们可能惩罚合理的风格重复，也可能奖励避开已知过度用词但整体写得很差的输出。

prompt set、judge model、generation settings 和 leaderboard refresh policy 没有完全核验，因此必须做 snapshot discipline。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use Creative Writing v3 as a subjective-generation evaluation example. It is useful for auditing how a benchmark reports style proxies alongside judge scores.

Reusable records should keep prompt, model output, judge model, rubric, score, repetition statistic, slop statistic, generation parameters, and leaderboard date.

For downstream evaluation, treat the leaderboard as a screening surface and pair it with human review or domain-specific rubrics before making product claims.

Creative Writing v3 适合作为 subjective-generation evaluation 的例子。它有助于审计一个 benchmark 如何在 judge score 旁边报告 style proxies。

可复用记录应保留 prompt、model output、judge model、rubric、score、repetition statistic、slop statistic、generation parameters 和 leaderboard date。

下游评估时，应把 leaderboard 当作 screening surface，并配合 human review 或 domain-specific rubrics，再做产品 claim。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the style columns as diagnostics, not as ground truth for literary quality. Repetition and slop can help identify failure modes but cannot define good writing alone.

Separate the benchmark score from the judge contract. Without prompt and judge snapshots, leaderboard rank is not a reproducible result.

This benchmark is useful precisely because it makes subjective evaluation risks visible.

把 style columns 当成 diagnostics，而不是 literary quality 的 ground truth。repetition 和 slop 可以帮助识别 failure modes，但不能单独定义好写作。

要把 benchmark score 和 judge contract 分开。没有 prompt 和 judge snapshots，leaderboard rank 就不是可复现结果。

这个 benchmark 的价值恰恰在于让 subjective evaluation risks 显性化。
